title: Bounded finite etale-local cohomology of a successor coefficient quotient
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, (A,I) an adic coefficient datum, and M an arbitrary derived object over its completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let phi identify every constant quotient ring with its actual completed quotient sheaf, and suppose these isomorphisms commute with consecutive quotient maps and completed scalar projections. Suppose the constant quotient realization functors preserve zero morphisms. Fix an etale chart V, integers a<=b and n>=0. Suppose the residue and nth reductions of M have etale-local constant finite-projective complex models in [a,b], in the predicate [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Put B=A/I^(n+2), R the actual next coefficient sheaf, and K the actual successor derived reduction. The ringed slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction] to V of H^q(K) is zero for q outside [a,b]. For every integer q and every etale W over V, an etale covering sieve of W trivializes H^q(K) as the restriction of ordinary scalar extension along phi_(n+1) of the lifted constant sheaf of a finite B-module. These are models of individual cohomology sheaves only; no complex or differentials are asserted.

source.place: Tags 094I and 094H; proetale.tex, Tag 09C2, coefficient-filtration step

proof.text: Construct the coefficient-filtration distinguished triangle with middle isomorphic to the actual successor reduction. Retain its bounded vanishing and finite etale-local homology models for the two outer terms; no middle homology assertion is included in this construction.

Restrict the degree-q long exact homology short complex to the slice over V. Slice restriction is additive and exact. Outside [a,b], both outer restricted homology objects are zero, so exactness makes the middle restricted homology zero. Transport it along the chosen middle-vertex isomorphism to the actual successor reduction.

Let P be the displayed property of etale-local finite module models over the successor coefficient sheaf. It is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions by the finite-coefficient heart theorem. Prove its isomorphism invariance by mapping an inverse isomorphism under each slice restriction and composing with each local model. The existing homologyProperty weak Serre API now gives P for every homology object of the middle term, from the two outer homology properties. Transport through the middle isomorphism and combine with the vanishing assertion.

theorem finiteQuotient_finiteModule_cohomology_succ
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hresidue : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M 0 V a b) (n : ℕ)
    (hprevious : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M n V a b) :
    let B := A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)
    let R₀ := completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1)
    let K := (completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M
    (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))) ∧
      ∀ (q : ℤ) (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K) ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                  koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
